fields.title: 📖 Adab before knowledge
fields.body:
🖋️ **Mālik ibn Anas** said to a young man from Quraysh:

> ***“Learn Adab before you learn knowledge.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Knowledge** without **Adab** can make a person proud and harsh. Therefore the path of the learner does not begin only with books, but with ***conduct, humility, and a right dealing with knowledge***.

immutable.source: 📝 Abū Nuʿaym, Ḥilyat al-Awliyāʾ wa Ṭabaqāt al-Aṣfiyāʾ, Band 6, S. 330; Aussage von Mālik ibn Anas.
